title: Alert snapshot lane with embedded postmortem drafts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Operators frequently open an alert in the Console and then hunt for a postmortem draft or incident notes in Confluence/Drive. This breaks context and increases time-to-capture for post-incident learnings. Goal: Add an "alert snapshot lane" in the incident/alert detail panel that surfaces a lightweight, editable postmortem draft and quick links to canonical documents without leaving the Console. The snapshot should be compact, searchable, and attachable to postmortem workflows (export to Drive/Confluence, link to PRs), and respect RBAC and audit requirements. This ticket covers UX exploration, a Figma prototype for the lane, and a short review with PM/Eng about data model constraints and persistence strategy.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Figma prototype shows a right-hand lane within alert detail with: compact incident summary, editable 'postmortem draft' textarea, quick-add bullet templates, and action buttons (Export to Drive, Create Postmortem, Attach GitHub PR). 2) Draft is clearly labelled as ephemeral unless the operator chooses 'Create Postmortem' which links into the canonical document flow. 3) Lane respects user permissions: read-only for some roles, editable for incident leads. 4) On prototype review, Eng confirms that a lightweight markdown blob per-alert is feasible without additional DB migrations. 5) Usability test (3 participants) shows >80% success on 'capture a postmortem note' task.
decisions:
- Keep draft length capped at 8k characters to avoid large payloads and to encourage moving to canonical docs.
- Use simple markdown subset (headings, bullets, code) for brevity.
- Provide 'Create Postmortem' export that pre-populates a Confluence template via the Console integration if the customer has Confluence connected.
- Default visibility set to 'team' within alert's org, with option to escalate to 'public' for cross-org sharing.
outstanding_questions: Where is the authoritative copy of the postmortem stored after 'Create Postmortem' - Confluence or internal DB? (PM wants Confluence but Eng flagged quota concerns)
Should 'draft' count toward audit logs as a write event or only the final 'Create Postmortem' action?
Can we reuse existing attachments API for exporting PR links, or do we need a new endpoint?

notes: Prototype prioritizes minimal distraction during incidents — UI should not encourage long-form authoring in the lane. Provide an inline 'Move to Postmortem' CTA that opens the full composer. Work with Security to ensure drafts are covered by existing audit logs if they contain PII. Follow-up ticket will capture backend retention/cleanup policy and Confluence integration details.
